newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Golden Valley soars on gold deal rumours.
newsitem.headline: Golden Valley soars on gold deal rumours.

text.p: Shares in Golden Valley Mines Ltd rose over 50 percent on Monday on speculation that it was close to forming a new deal on a gold project.
At 12.30 p.m. (0230 GMT), Golden Valley shares were 22 cents or 51.16 percent up at 65 cents.
"What we are hearing is that there are a couple of deals about to be announced," one Perth-based dealer said.
But he could not add any more details.

The dealer said there was also speculation that some of the gold samples from the controversial Busang project in Indonesia had produced good results from the sample tests that are being carried out in Perth at the moment.
"There is also better sentiment for the minors at the moment following the Carpenter Pacific result," he said.
Carpenter Pacific last week announced promising drill results from the Mt Kare gold project in Papua New Guinea.
Golden Valley has a technical and financial agreement with Indonesian company PT Krueng Gasui (KG), controlled by businessman Joseph Merukh.
KG owns an undisputed 10 percent stake in the Muara Atan contract of work containing part of the Busang deposit.
